segments.name: IT services
segments.description: Provides AI-powered technology and data-driven professional services, including IT services and data solutions, for corporate and financial clients.
segments.evidence: We generate revenue primarily by providing IT services, data solutions, and AI-powered services and technology solutions to our customers and partners for service fees.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay service fees to the company for IT services, data solutions and AI-powered technology solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily by providing IT services, data solutions, and AI-powered services and technology solutions to our customers and partners for service fees.

changes.text: In 2025 the company discontinued its legacy SME financing and supply chain businesses in mainland China.
changes.evidence: As a result of this transaction, we have discontinued our legacy SME financing services business in mainland China and supply chain businesses.

changes.text: In 2025 the company began its AI and technology-enabled professional services business by acquiring YD Network.
changes.evidence: On December 1, 2025, we commenced our new business segment in artificial intelligence and technology-enabled professional services through the acquisition of YD Network Technology Company Limited, a company specialized in providing information technology services in Hong Kong, for a total consideration of US$50,000.

changes.text: In 2026 the company renamed itself AIOS Tech Inc., completing its exit from legacy business lines.
changes.evidence: This rebranding marks the completion of our exit from legacy business lines and our full transition to the artificial intelligence and information technology sectors.
